mark_split.label: The botanist and his three classes

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack botany section, Chapter 13, book p.35, VSAQ 7. BOOK ERROR: the book prints the name as 'Eugen warming'. The botanist is Eugenius Warming (1841-1924), the Danish botanist regarded as the founder of ecology; his 1895 book Plantesamfund set out the hydrophyte / mesophyte / xerophyte classes. The card writes the name correctly and notes the book's spelling. The book's question also reads 'Define communities?'; it is written as 'Define community' here. Only one source book is held for botany — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand is physics-only and no botany board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card, not merely unrun. The 1+1 split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

steps.label: Definition
lines: Community: the assemblage of all the
A plant community is the plant part of it.
steps.why: A community is defined one level above a population, so the definition must contain the word populations and the word area.
common_mistakes: Defining it as one species in an area. That is a population.
Including the soil, water and climate. That makes it an ecosystem.
steps.memory_tip: Many populations in one area = one community.
steps.margin_note: One sentence. The second mark is the name, so do not spend time here.

steps.label: The botanist and his three classes
lines: He is regarded as the founder of ecology.
He grouped plant communities by the water
steps.why: Warming grouped communities by ONE factor, the water available in the habitat, which is why the three names all end in -phyte and differ only in the water word.
common_mistakes: Writing Eugen Warming, the spelling this book prints. The name is Eugenius Warming.
Naming Odum or Clements. Clements named the climax concept; Warming named these three classes.
steps.memory_tip: Three water levels, three classes: hydro = plenty, meso = medium, xero = little.
steps.margin_note: Name plus the three classes. Nothing else is needed for this mark.

insider_note: The name is the mark here, and it is the part students blank on. Fix it by the meaning of his classes: Warming sorted plants by water — hydro, meso, xero.
